notes: The database is created automatically when the backend starts if it does not exist.
The MVP seeds one user and one board for the hardcoded sign-in flow.
The tables support multiple users and boards even though the MVP uses one board per user.

users.purpose: A future-proof account boundary for board ownership.

password_hash.description: Stored password hash. The MVP seed may use a placeholder until real authentication is introduced.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp stored as an ISO-8601 string.

boards.purpose: A Kanban board owned by one user.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp stored as an ISO-8601 string.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp updated after board mutations.

constraints: UNIQUE(user_id) for the MVP one-board-per-user rule
The unique constraint can be removed in a future migration if users may own multiple boards.

columns.purpose: Ordered workflow stages belonging to a board.

position.description: Zero-based display order within the board.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp stored as an ISO-8601 string.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp updated after title or position changes.

cards.purpose: Editable work items assigned to a board column.

board_id.description: The board containing this card; supports user and board scoping.

column_id.description: The current column. Enforced with a composite foreign key to keep cards on the same board.

position.description: Zero-based display order within the column.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp stored as an ISO-8601 string.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp updated after card mutations.

constraints: FOREIGN KEY(board_id, column_id) REFERENCES columns(board_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
The composite foreign key prevents assigning a card to a column on another board.

relationships: users 1-to-many boards, with UNIQUE(boards.user_id) enforcing one board per user for the MVP
Deleting a user cascades to their boards, columns, and cards
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_columns_board_position ON columns(board_id, position)
CREATE INDEX idx_cards_board_column_position ON cards(board_id, column_id, position)

frontendBoardData.columns: SELECT id, title, position ORDER BY position; cardIds are derived from cards ordered by position
frontendBoardData.cards: SELECT id, title, details, column_id, position and group by column_id
frontendBoardData.moveCard: Update card.column_id and card.position values in one transaction, then normalize affected positions
frontendBoardData.createCard: Insert a card at the end of the target column
frontendBoardData.deleteCard: Delete the card and normalize remaining positions in its column

approval.requestedDecision: Approve this schema before Part 6 database initialization and persistence API implementation.
